headlines.text: On this day in 2023, Darby Allin vs. Nick Wayne met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.53.

Rewind to 2024, when Brody King reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Brody King vs. Malakai Black vs. Mansoor vs. Mason Madden, headlining the show on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a strong outing in a back-and-forth tag team affair.

That Friday in 2024, Bryan Danielson chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match ? a real landmark moment, facing Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. Young Bucks & Okada vs. The Young Bucks vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. PAC vs. Matthew Jackson vs. Nicholas Jackson vs. Kazuchika Okada vs. Jack Perry, getting things started right out of the gate on Rampage, rated 7.49 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2023, when Le Sex Gods kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.82.
That Friday in 2024, Mark Briscoe vs. Lance Archer met in a Qualifying Match, getting things started right out of the gate on Collision, rated 7.20 ? a well-worked match.
